commit.message:
fix(security): [1.2.x] harden user settings validation, Guest writes, and realtime graph access (#9014)

* Harden user settings validation, Guest write restrictions, and realtime graph access

Validate user preference values against $settings_user field schemas in
auth_profile.php and save_user_settings(), enforce POST/CSRF on
auth_profile.php?action=update_data, and reject Guest account mutations
across profile and realtime endpoints.

Validate preview and tree graph pagination and column settings before
building SQL LIMIT clauses or rendering JavaScript configuration values.

Enforce is_graph_allowed() before realtime poller execution and cache
reads in graph_realtime.php, anchor the graph_nolegend regex, validate
sess_realtime_hash, and clamp realtime intervals before shell execution.

Signed-off-by: Thomas Vincent <thomasvincent@gmail.com>

* test(security): require lib/html_graph.php directly instead of eval in hardening test

Signed-off-by: Thomas Vincent <thomasvincent@gmail.com>

---------

Signed-off-by: Thomas Vincent <thomasvincent@gmail.com>

commit.message:
fix(i18n): [1.2.x] fix gettext runtime, RTL direction, JS string encoding, and catalog defects (#8992)

* fix(i18n): [1.2.x] fix positional printf, %% escaping, number_format_i18n, and RRD LANG handling

Allow positional format specifiers (%1$s, %2$d, %1$.2f) in __() and __x() so translated strings using reordered arguments pass through sprintf().

Preserve %% in __gettext() until after sprintf() runs in __() and __x(), and guard __x() so messages without conversion specifiers do not fail on literal % under PHP 8.

In number_format_i18n(), normalize ICU locale keys instead of duplicating the country code, apply $baseu K/M/G/T scaling consistently in the ext-intl path, query setlocale(LC_ALL, '0'), and restore LC_ALL using the string category name under PHP 8.

Fix the $path2msfiler typo, check $config['i18n_text_log'] in i18n_text_debug(), add get_locale_direction(), and update rrdtool_set_language()/rrdtool_reset_language() to use C.UTF-8 with LC_NUMERIC=C and unset LANG/LC_NUMERIC when previously unset.

Refs #8988

Signed-off-by: Thomas Vincent <thomasvincent@gmail.com>

* fix(i18n): [1.2.x] emit dir attribute on HTML roots from active locale direction

Use get_locale_direction() to emit dir='rtl' or dir='ltr' on <html> elements in top headers, auth pages, installer, and realtime graph pages.

Refs #8988

Signed-off-by: Thomas Vincent <thomasvincent@gmail.com>

* fix(i18n): [1.2.x] encode translated JavaScript string literals with json_encode

Emit translated strings embedded in inline JavaScript blocks via json_encode() so apostrophes and quotes in translations cannot break script parsing, and avoid literal HTML entities in plain JS string contexts.

Refs #8555, #8988

Signed-off-by: Thomas Vincent <thomasvincent@gmail.com>

* fix(i18n): [1.2.x] repair shipped PO catalog defects and recompile modified MO binaries

Repair mechanical defects across shipped catalogs and recompile modified .mo binaries:
- Fix inverted hi-IN.po Plural-Forms (plural=n > 1;)
- Fix stale msgstr placeholders, corrupted strftime format tokens, HTML tag count/name/balance defects, stray Unicode bidi overrides, spaced |variable| tokens, and baked-in HTML entities absent from msgid
- Recompile all modified locales/LC_MESSAGES/*.mo binaries

Refs #8988

Signed-off-by: Thomas Vincent <thomasvincent@gmail.com>

* test(i18n): [1.2.x] add runtime, RTL, RRD LANG, and JS encoding regression tests

Add unit tests covering positional printf specifiers, %% preservation before sprintf(), __x() literal percent safety, number_format_i18n() scaling and LC_NUMERIC preservation, get_locale_direction(), rrdtool_set_language()/rrdtool_reset_language(), and json_encode JS string embedding.

Refs #8988

Signed-off-by: Thomas Vincent <thomasvincent@gmail.com>

* Cast data_input id to int and expand i18n coverage fixture

Refs #8988

Signed-off-by: Thomas Vincent <thomasvincent@gmail.com>

---------

Signed-off-by: Thomas Vincent <thomasvincent@gmail.com>
